
```jsx
import { CxTable } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxTable from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/table/CxTable'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **align** | Set the vertical aligment. | `'bottom'` \| `'middle'` \| `'top'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **borderColor** | Sets the border context of the component to one of Bootstrap React’s themed colors. | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'success'` \| `'danger'` \| `'warning'` \| `'info'` \| `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `string` | - |
| **bordered** | Add borders on all sides of the table and cells. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **borderless** | Remove borders on all sides of the table and cells. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **caption** | Put the `<caption>` on the top of the table. | `'top'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **context** | Sets the context context of the component to one of Bootstrap React’s themed colors. | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'success'` \| `'danger'` \| `'warning'` \| `'info'` \| `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `string` | - |
| **hover** | Enable a hover state on table rows within a `<CxTableBody>`. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **responsive** | Make any table responsive across all viewports or pick a maximum breakpoint with which to have a responsive table up to. | `boolean` \| `'small'` \| `'medium'` \| `'large'` \| `'xlarge'` \| `'2xlarge'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **small** | Make table more compact by cutting all cell `padding` in half. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **striped** | Add zebra-striping to any table row within the `<CxTableBody>`. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
